title: hieracium compositum subsp. catalaunicum
intro: Hieracium compositum subsp. catalaunicum, commonly known as Hieracium catalaunicum, is a plant species within the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium catalaunicum include modulating the immune system, exhibiting antitumor activity, and having a protective effect on the cardiovascular system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
